title: Green synthesis of ZnO and α-Fe2O3 nanoparticles using Chinese fan palm leaf extract for their biological and photocatalytic activity evaluation
content:

This study presents the green synthesis of zinc oxide (ZnO) and hematite (α-Fe2O3) nanoparticles (NPs) using Livistona chinensis (Chinese fan palm) leaf extract as a natural reducing and capping agent.
